metadata.name: Franklin D. Roosevelt
metadata.description: US president who introduced the New Deal, expanded federal social provision and led the United States during most of the Second World War.
metadata.scope: Personal positions and governing conduct during 1933–1945; earlier writings are contextual only. Historical analogies to contemporary technologies are explicitly inferred, not claims that the subject answered a modern questionnaire. Coalition constraints and contradictions are identified by axis.

review.notes: Independently read all 240 answers and all axis briefs/counterarguments against exact wording. Cross-checked the 1944 economic-rights address, Miller Center domestic record and Holocaust Museum refugee assessment. Retained wartime internment, quota restrictions and judicial conflict as counter-evidence to idealised liberties and democratic scores; distinguished mixed New Deal ownership from permanent production planning. Corrected firearm regulation versus qualified permission, official clerical review versus a veto, and religious instruction versus an assumed compulsory form. Moderated the common-foreign-policy and modern AI reliability inferences. Neutral medical/ownership and federalism positions express conditional public-private and institutional mixtures. Contemporary scientific items are analogies, not claims of expressed modern views. Portrait and full-catalogue similarity follow during integration. Integration review by OpenAI Codex /root on 2026-10-04: portrait identity, local rendering, size and Commons attribution checked; the shared Image credits list includes this source. All 35 requested profiles were compared using calculated scores, with any resemblance at or above 95% explicitly reviewed against the named revision. Neutral-count warnings were retained only after the evidence review; they are not missing answers. Portrait integration review by OpenAI Codex on 2026-10-04: verified the Wikipedia infobox file, Commons creator and reuse status, and image size. The independent political evidence audit is retained; no political assessment changed.
